string.name: onb_welcome_body
string.value: For people with Long QT syndrome: check a medicine before you take it, let your watch keep an eye on your heart rate, and get help fast in an emergency.

string.name: onb_welcome_time
string.value: Setup takes about two minutes. Most steps can be skipped and finished later in Settings.

string.name: onb_welcome_consent
string.value: I understand this app is not a medical device. I will always ask my doctor or pharmacist.

string.name: onb_account_subtitle
string.value: Sign in once and your profile comes back on a new phone. The app keeps working offline.

string.name: onb_account_skip_note
string.value: No account? Everything still works and stays on this phone.

string.name: onb_about_subtitle
string.value: Shown on your emergency card and used to tune the advice you get.

string.name: onb_genotype_help
string.value: It is on your genetic test report. If you are not sure, the app uses the most careful advice.

string.name: onb_details_subtitle
string.value: What paramedics should know. You choose what appears on your shared card.

string.name: onb_perm_subtitle
string.value: Allow only what you want. You can change it later in Settings.

string.name: onb_perm_notif_why
string.value: So heart alerts and medicine reminders reach you when the app is closed.

string.name: onb_perm_mic_why
string.value: So you can ask the agent about a medicine by voice.

string.name: onb_perm_loc_why
string.value: So an SOS message can tell your contacts where you are.

string.name: onb_perm_denied
string.value: Not allowed. You can turn it on in the phone's Settings.

string.name: onb_watch_subtitle
string.value: Your watch sends your heart rate, so the agent can check on you when something looks unusual.

string.name: onb_watch_later
string.value: No watch? You can pair one later in Settings.

string.name: onb_privacy_account
string.value: Your profile is kept on this phone and, when you are signed in, in your account.
